prompt.project_info: Create a candid 3:4 close-up selfie of two approved adults inside a car at golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adult women, one dominant brunette with a butterfly hair clip and warm natural makeup, wearing an opaque white ribbed top; the second with dark hair in a black graphic T-shirt, leaning close in a friendly non-sexual interaction.
prompt.composition_elements: Handheld slightly high wide-angle car selfie, grey patterned seats, headrests, rearview mirror, optional gold beaded car accessory, blurred trees and bright sky through rear window, both faces visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm hazy sunlight from the right with soft shadows, sun flare and washed contrast, candid social-media atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 smartphone selfie, wide phone lens, slightly soft focus, subtle grain and lens flare, realistic car interior texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A candid 3:4 handheld wide-angle selfie of two approved adult women inside a car at golden hour. The dominant subject has long dark wavy brown hair with a small pink butterfly clip, warm natural skin, and soft makeup, wearing an opaque white ribbed top and seatbelt. The second woman has dark hair pulled back and wears a black graphic T-shirt, leaning close with a friendly smile rather than sexual contact. Include grey patterned car seats, headrests, rearview mirror, optional gold beaded car accessory, and a rear window with blurred trees and bright sky. Warm hazy sunlight enters from the right with soft shadows, lens flare, slightly washed contrast, natural grain, and candid social-media texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, cleavage, licking, tongue contact, intimate sexual action, body-part emphasis, nudity, unverified logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required composition reference.
